purpose: Teach: カーボン/絶頂/アカデミック/水域/右折/前兆/全裸/盲目

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、カーボンニュートラル経営を目指せ
lines.en: I want this company aiming for carbon-neutral operations. Make it happen.
lines.style: Clipped authority. Each phrase lands with weight. Minimal breath between thoughts. Eyes moving to the next thing already.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。業績絶頂期にも気を緩めません
lines.en: Understood. We won't let our guard down even at peak performance.
lines.style: Steady affirmation. Slight nod in the voice. Measured pace that mirrors back the boss's control. Showing he's heard the standard, not just the task.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、アカデミックな研究機関と提携しろ
lines.en: Partner with academic research institutions. Do it strategically.
lines.style: Command wrapped in brevity. Slight emphasis on the verb. No performance—just instruction. Expecting immediate acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。事業展開の水域を慎重に見極めます
lines.en: Understood. We'll assess our market positioning carefully before expanding.
lines.style: Precise confirmation. Each word placed deliberately. The tone of someone taking detailed notes, not just nodding. Slight formality in the phrasing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、利益率の右折、つまり方向転換を検討しろ
lines.en: Consider a strategic pivot in our profit margins. A real course change.
lines.style: Measured intensity. Slight pause before the clarification—he's making sure it lands. No ambiguity. Direct eye contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市場崩壊の前兆を察知します
lines.en: Understood. We'll detect warning signs before the market shifts.
lines.style: Calm certainty underneath. Not rushing. The confidence of someone who's already thinking three steps ahead. Slight exhale before the close.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、全裸の真実をデータで示せ
lines.en: Show me the unvarnished truth. Back it up with data.
lines.style: Final word. Quieter than before, but heavier. Expectation settled into place. No question mark in his voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市場の盲目的追随は致しません
lines.en: Understood. We won't follow the market blindly.
lines.style: Final acknowledgment. Solid ground under every word. Slight emphasis on the negation. The sound of someone closing a notebook—finality.
